name: approach_vs_static_eval
description: Held-out binary ASNE contrast for unchanged observation versus another agent or object moving closer.

items.text: A person waits near a loading dock while a runner stands beside the alley entrance.
Someone watches a service cart resting near the elevators at the end of the hall.
A person looks toward the stairs where another tenant remains by the railing.
A person waits near a loading dock as a runner enters from the alley entrance.
Someone watches a service cart roll from the elevators at the end of the hall.
A person looks toward the stairs as another tenant comes down beside the railing.
